finding.statement: Current execution_replay_identity still includes delta_id, and measured_packet also carries delta_id. Supervisor-8.73 review already classified delta_id as candidate/evaluation-envelope identity rather than measured-execution identity. A delta_id-only replay can therefore receive a different replay digest and different training-bearing packet bytes even when source, worker, target blobs, execution admission, metric and measured evidence are unchanged.
finding.existing_regression_gap: tests/test_forge_distillery_replay_identity_873.py covers timestamp/narration mutation but does not hold measured execution fixed while changing only delta_id.

hypothesis: Removing envelope-only delta_id from the stable execution replay identity and measured training packet preimage, while retaining it as observation/candidate provenance metadata, makes semantically identical measured executions replay-stable without collapsing genuinely distinct execution evidence.
counterhypothesis: delta_id is itself a deterministic function of the exact measured execution and therefore belongs in stable replay identity.
counterhypothesis_status: UNPROVEN; current producer path derives candidate delta_id from proposal/candidate data, and no admitted contract proving exact measured-execution derivation was found during this macrocycle.

acceptance: delta_id-only mutation must not alter execution_replay_identity
delta_id-only mutation must not alter measured_packet or measured_evidence_identity
second ingest of same measured execution with only delta_id changed must classify DUPLICATE with accepted_dataset_tokens delta +0
fresh rebuilds differing only in delta_id must emit byte-identical packet text, packet id, replay digest, measured digest and token count

next_exact_gate: Implement the narrow successor on current main: exclude delta_id from CLAY_FORGE_EXECUTION_REPLAY_IDENTITY/v1 and CLAY_DISTILLERY_FORGE_EXECUTION_PACKET measured preimage, preserve delta_id only as provenance metadata, then execute the new regression together with timestamp/narration rebuild-stability and concurrent replay-admission tests on an admitted zero-cost exact-source surface.
